name: decodes nested and adjacent groups
input: nested groups and literal text between repeated groups
test:
assert decode_suffix_repeats('x(y(z){3}){2}') == 'xyzzzyzzz'
assert decode_suffix_repeats('pq(rs){2}t') == 'pqrsrst'
assert decode_suffix_repeats('(m){3}n(o){2}') == 'mmmnoo'

name: supports absent, zero, and multi-digit suffixes
input: groups with no suffix, a zero suffix, and a twelve-times suffix
test:
assert decode_suffix_repeats('a(b)c') == 'abc'
assert decode_suffix_repeats('r(st){0}v(w){12}') == 'rv' + 'w' * 12
assert decode_suffix_repeats('(ab){10}') == 'ab' * 10

name: does not apply a suffix to later literal text
input: two repeated groups separated by a literal
